page.layout: One page of text in a single column, no marginal notes. Running head at the top left, page number at the top right. Gathering signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: locis historias Christianorum recensens Hegiræ annos semper usurpat. Sed de hisce hactenus.

Posteriores Litteræ tuæ mihi lecto decumbenti redditæ sunt, sed tui nominis jucunda recordatione animum recrea-runt, febrisque ardorem elevarunt. Quæ-ris à me, eruditissime Domine, num per Judæorum Cabbalisticam Gematriam, numeri ex dictionis resolutione manan-tes, soleant iterum in dictionem coale-scere, qua Mysterium aliquod significe-tur; exemplo tuo quæstionis sensum a-periam. ישוע[?] Jesus, Arabice componit 146, numero illo iterum in litteras reso-luto exoritur dictio [illegible, ~3 letters], quæ Arabice inservire sonat, recte de Domino nostro dicitur, qui formam Servi induit, &c. Respondeo, Gematriæ Cabbalisticæ genium esse, dictionis unius sensum aut mysterium, ex alia per numeros expiscari, atque ad id tantum Gematriam inventam esse, hincque sæpius mysteria e-mergere. Huic conformia quod ex A-rabica Lingua adnotasti, verbi gratia di-

page.notes: The Hebrew word after "Jesus" is read as ישוע with doubt; the second Hebrew word after "dictio" is too faint to read and is marked illegible. The catchword is partly cut off at the left edge of the scan, so the first letter is read as d with doubt. The Hebrew letters are small and set in a different typeface, so check them against the original.
